correctness.rationale: Every permissible (t,e) decomposes into rooted-star and two-cycle functional components of t; e has a uniquely rooted fiber-block for each of its image points because te=et=e²=e. This yields a bijection with multisets of blocks counted by B and C. A two-cycle is equivalent to t≠t². The Euler transform and divisor-sum recurrence follow formally. Direct independent enumeration of all compatible pairs and Sn conjugacy orbits at n=1..5 matches the series exactly (r3=0,0,1,4,15), and the published classification associates these to rank-three endomorphisms. Finite testing is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is exactly the rank-three orbit-count generating function singled out as a missing piece of minimal generator enumeration by Gould-Grau-Johnson (2023) Section 8. It provides a canonical classification, an explicit ordinary generating function, and effective integer recurrence for all n≥5. These are nontrivial whole-family structural and enumerative results, not routine small finite computations. It deliberately does not claim the still-undetermined rank-two orbit contribution or total asymptotics.
